$comment: Identity injected into shared registry fixtures at render time (ADR-026 §3, ADR-030). Fields the blueprint owns (siteName, siteUrl, personName) are asserted against apps/syed-ai/content/syed-ai.blueprint.json by a unit test and must not drift. The rest are the strings a blueprint cannot express: the wordmark's accent split, the role line, the monogram path, office rows and the hero's alt text.
heroAlt: Syed Abdul of syed.ai, generative engine optimization and AI search consultant, in a corner office at dusk
